title: Local groups plan protest against Donald Trump rally in Daytona Beach
seoTitle: Daytona Beach protest against Donald Trump rally

tea.why: Local groups are protesting President Donald Trump's campaign visit to Daytona Beach ahead of upcoming elections and potential business impacts.
tea.want: Protesters plan to voice opposition to the political figures and policies being supported at the rally.
tea.changed: Oct 28: Local protest groups announced plans to demonstrate outside the Ocean Center venue in Daytona Beach during the campaign event.

summary: Several local organizations in Volusia and Flagler counties, including the Port Orange Democratic Club, Just Us Volusia, Volusia Democratic Socialists of America, and Flagler 5051, announced plans to hold a demonstration outside the Ocean Center in Daytona Beach, Florida. The protest coincides with a campaign rally featuring President Donald Trump, who is visiting the area to support Republican candidates, including gubernatorial candidate Byron Donalds and Senate candidate Ashley Moody. Organizers expressed concerns regarding political representation, alleged misuse of funds, and the timing of the event during the Halloween weekend, which they argue could disrupt local beachside businesses. No official response or counter-measures from authorities regarding the planned demonstrations were detailed in the sources beyond expected road closures.
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Local activist groups announced upcoming protests outside the Ocean Center venue in Daytona Beach ahead of a scheduled campaign visit.
